content.title: Where to Watch the Champions League on TV
content.text: The UEFA Champions League kicks off its 71st season in 2025 and Xfinity will keep you connected all season long, until the final in Budapest, Hungary on Saturday May 30th, 2026. Here is where you can watch and stream the 2025-26 season of the UEFA Champions League: You can watch a selection of UEFA Champions League games on CBS, Univision and VIX, as well as live stream and on-demand matches on Paramount+. Watch Champions League and so much more with World Soccer Ticket To watch the UEFA Champions League and more in the U.S, sign up to Xfinity’s World Soccer Ticket, a video package custom-built for soccer fans offering access to matches from the world’s best leagues. This personalized soccer hub brings all the action to you in one place, making it easy to follow your favorite teams and leagues. With World Soccer Ticket, you get: More than 1,500 matches from around the world. Matches from Premier League to La Liga, Champions League and the best of MLS all in one place in English and Spanish. Up to four matches at once with Multiview. Live match scores, stats, and odds. Plus, at no additional cost: One X1 Box The Xfinity Stream app for on-the-go viewing Peacock Premium (currently a $10.99/mo value) And with Xfinity StreamStore, X1 makes it easy for customers to customize World Soccer Ticket with additional streaming services like MLS Season Pass, Paramount+ and ESPN+. Don’t miss a second with Xfinity Multiview Torn between matches? With Xfinity Muiltiview, you can watch multiple events on one screen. Now, you can watch up to four soccer matches at once, or side-by-side with your favorite college football and NFL teams, so you won’t miss a thing. Get started by saying “Multiview” into your Xfinity voice remote. Viewers with 4K-compatible X1 devices can create a Multiview experience from the selection of live sports and special events available in their channel lineup. Not sure if you have a compatible X1 box? Find out here. Get Live Updates with Xfinity Sports Zone X1 customers have access to Xfinity Sports Zone for coverage and stats for the Champions League, Premier League, MLS, La Liga, Liga MX, and more: Live games Scores of all live games Coverage of the games you aren’t watching Upcoming league schedules Want to access the latest scores and info on your favorite leagues and teams, and track multiple games? Say “Soccer” or “Muéstrame fútbol” (when Spanish voice search language is enabled) into your X1voice remote. UEFA Champions League 2025-26 Schedule Qualifying Rounds and Playoffs First qualifying round: June 17, 2025 Second qualifying round: June 18, 2025 Third qualifying round: July 21, 2025 Playoffs: August 4, 2025 League phase: August 28, 2025 League Phase Matches Matchday 1: September 16-18, 2025 Matchday 2: September 30 – October 1, 2025 Matchday 3: October 21-22, 2025 Matchday 4: November 4-5, 2025 Matchday 5: November 25-26 2025 Matchday 6: December 9-10, 2025 Matchday 7: January 20-21, 2026 Matchday 8: January 28, 2026 Knockout Phase Matches and Playoffs Knockout phase play-offs: February 17-18 & 24-25, 2026 Round of 16: March 10-11 & 17-18, 2026 Quarter-finals: April 7-8 & 14-15, 2026 Semi-finals: April 28-29 & May 5-6, 2026 Final: May 30, 2026 (Budapest) Find all the 2025-26 UEFA Champions League schedule details here.
